Follow the order of operations: the division comes before the addition and subtraction.

$\dfrac15\div\dfrac34=\dfrac15\times\dfrac43=\dfrac{4}{15}$.

Then $\dfrac23+\dfrac4{15}-\dfrac13=\dfrac{10}{15}+\dfrac{4}{15}-\dfrac{5}{15}=\dfrac{9}{15}=\dfrac35$.

**Answer: $\dfrac35$** (that is $0.6$).
